evidence.reason: In boot(), the child is spawned at line 712 and the launch record write at 714-715 sits before the try/except cleanup at 730-753. If Recorder.append() raises (e.g. journal write error), boot() propagates without entering the cleanup block, so the spawned systemd-run/qemu process is neither terminated nor waited/reaped and qemu.log is not closed; the caller also has no process.json identity to use for scope cleanup. Moving the append inside the try (or otherwise arming cleanup before the record write) is a routine correctness fix, not an owner decision.
